    Nebraska Cornhuskers vs. Vanderbilt Commodores NCAA Tournament second-round game on Saturday, March 21, 2026, airs on TNT. The game is scheduled to tip off around 7:45 p.m. CT (8:45 p.m. ET) from the Paycom Center. 
    • TV Channel: TNT
    • Streaming Options: Sling TV, Paramount+, FuboTV, or March Madness Live. 
    The game, featuring the No. 4 seed Cornhuskers and No. 5 seed Commodores, follows the earlier Houston vs. Texas A&M matchup at the same venue.
